name: External Hreflang
description: Allow adding alternate hreflang for external sites (not languages in Drupal).
project_description:
This project allows adding alternate hreflang for external sites

(not languages in Drupal).

 This project requires metatag project and to complete it just access your metatag configuration and you'll check a new field called "External Hreflang".

 Scenario: We have a site in Drupal for one country / market and it's other country sites are managed by different team or may it is separate Drupal installation.

 Site 1: US with languages EN, ES, FR

Site 2: UK with language EN

Site 3: FR with languages EN, FR

 Now if we want to add reference (hreflang) of FR of Site 3 in Site 1, this module is for you.
